name: Onsen no Otokoyu de Otoko o Asaru Loli Bitch
original_name: 温泉の男湯で男を漁るロリビッチ
source:
Someone brought a cute little number to the onsen. She's so cute and naked and tiny, chatting with everyone, precocious and mischievous. She knows it. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179536.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有人带了一个可爱的小数字到温泉。她是如此可爱，赤身露体，身材娇小，和每个人聊天，早熟又调皮。她知道。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179536.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
